brand.tagline: Lucky - digital house lottery draw portal
brand.demo: Demo version, not a live service - Ethiopian birr - Telebirr
hero.title: Pick your number, pay with Telebirr, and the lottery draw happens inside that house.
hero.body: Every house has its own price. One house is 20 birr, one is 100 birr, one is 5000 birr. When a house is full, the lottery draw runs automatically between the participants of that house, and the whole prize pool goes to 3 winning numbers.
hero.rule: The number you hold is public. Your name is never stored and never shown.

rules.title: House rules
rules.price: Each house has its own price. The price is not equal to the number of participants.
rules.pick: You choose the number yourself. Free numbers are open to everyone in the house.
rules.hold: One person may hold up to {0} numbers in a house.
rules.pay: You pay through your Telebirr digital wallet. A number becomes yours only after Telebirr confirms the payment.
rules.fee: Each participant pays the house price and nothing extra. The service charge is cut out of that money: it is twenty five percent of the payment. What is left goes to the prize pool. In a twenty birr house five birr is the service charge and fifteen birr goes to the prizes.
rules.draw: When the house is full the lottery draw runs automatically between its participants. Three numbers take the whole prize pool: 1st, 2nd and 3rd.
rules.fair: The three places go to different people. As long as a person who has not won yet has a number left, no person gets more than one place.
rules.fairTitle: Who the three places go to
rules.privacy: Everyone sees numbers and prices. Nobody sees names or phone numbers.
footer.note: Lucky is a demo of a lottery draw flow. Running it with real money needs a Telebirr merchant contract and a licence for the lottery draw itself.
